title: Binder: canonicalize numeric member names (GetPropertyNameForPropertyNameNode)
description: Upstream names a numeric member by the scanner's canonical value (0b11 binds as '3', 1.0 as '1'; ast/utilities.go:3160 Text() = token value), so duplicate spellings merge into one symbol. This binder keys the source text, so they stay two symbols. Fix needs an owned string with the store's lifetime — thread an arena through FileInfo/bind_into (140 construction sites) or carry the canonical value on NumericLiteral via codegen. ~6 binder_symbols cases: duplicateIdentifierDifferentSpelling, numericClassMembers1, objectTypeWithDuplicateNumericProperty, dynamicNamesErrors, numericStringNamedPropertyEquivalence, duplicateObjectLiteralProperty_computedName1. Also unblocks the recorded signed-numeric gap in dynamic_name (binder.rs).
close_reason: Landed at 2c3de45: canonical numeric member names via arena-threaded bind API + jsnum in tsr-core; binder_symbols 8,411/8,473, checker_types +1.

title: Binder: JSDoc typedef/callback/template/overload declarations
description: The largest remaining binder_symbols family (~10 cases: jsdocTemplateTag3/6, typedefOnStatements, typedefTagNested, checkJsdocTypedefInParamTag1, thisTag1, overloadTag1, jsFileMethodOverloads, expandoFunctionContextualTypesJs, moduleExportsAliasLoop2, propertyAssignmentUseParentType1). Upstream reparses JSDoc tags into declarations the binder files — a @typedef declares a type alias whose declaration line is the comment's. The parser holds a JSDocTable side table with registered spans; the binder never sees it. Route: pass the table through FileInfo (the arena precedent at 2c3de45 shows the shape) and bind typedef/callback as type aliases, @template as type parameters, @overload as extra declaration list entries.

title: Binder suite: module augmentation of re-exports and export-assignment targets
description: ~8 cases: augmentExportEquals3/4/6 (import x = require of an export-assigned module, augmented cross-file — x.b wants the augmentation's member), moduleAugmentationDoes*Reexport (ns.Foo.self through import * of a re-export plus declare-module augmentation), moduleDeclarationExportStarShadowingGlobalIsNameable, ambientExternalModuleWithRelativeModuleName. Upstream merges augmentations in the checker (mergeModuleAugmentation); the suite's transparency layer would need cross-file module resolution plus augmentation-table union. The namespace_import_target helper at 024689c is the seam to extend.
